aggregation: overlap-area-weighted classified-area fraction within exact 500m cells
year_policy: cache all24observed selected Spring group/year combinations; select training-only representative years after animal split

grassland.meaning: natural grass-dominated vegetation; Bolivia combined grassland/shrubland accepted; excludes managed pasture

flooded_habitat.meaning: Alvarenga narrow flood-influenced herbaceous/shrubby vegetation; excludes open water, flooded forest, flooded savanna

shrubland.meaning: area classified as shrubland/evergreen shrubland/deciduous shrubland, not canopy cover

gap_only_fallback.condition: all3national sources missing; no replacement of valid non-target classes

source_versions: pinned in each immutable extraction bundle and source snapshot
